articles.title: Fidelity files with SEC to add staking to Ethereum ETF
articles.snippet: Fidelity plans to add staking to its Ether fund, with 85% of rewards retained by FETH and quarterly cash distributions planned for investors.

articles.title: After Coldcard Was Hacked, $15 Billion in Bitcoin Moved to Safety
articles.snippet: Casa CEO Nick Neuman says the mass Bitcoin migration after the $130M Coldcard exploit proves distributed self-custody is Bitcoin's immune system—not its vulnerability.

articles.title: Fidelity Files to Let Its Ethereum ETF Stake and Pay Investors
articles.snippet: The Boston asset manager's FETH would stake up to 100% of its ETH and distribute the rewards to holders as quarterly cash, pending SEC approval.

articles.title: Another OpenAI Exec Quits in Leadership Shake-Up as AI Giant Eyes IPO
articles.snippet: The former operating chief is starting a new venture following several departures across the ChatGPT developer’s leadership and safety teams.

articles.title: OpenAI's Only Dedicated Ethicist Has Left With No Replacement: FT
articles.snippet: Chloé Bakalar joined from Meta last August and departed in July without any announcement, one of several safety exits in recent weeks.
